snippet.title: Beatable Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
BEATABLE: XR Games & VR Star Naysy Unveil the Next Era of Rhythm Gaming

XR Games and VR Star Naysy are excited to announce BEATABLE, a Mixed Reality rhythm game designed for hand tracking with physical interaction. Launching 10th April 2025 in Early Access on Meta Quest, players can pre-order now for a 10% discount or add to your wishlist (https://www.meta.com/en-gb/experiences/beatable/9013855882035562/)

Forget controllers—BEATABLE transforms any table into a musical instrument. Tap, snap, and clap to the beat using just your hands! With real-world haptics, responsive gesture recognition, and precision-tuned controls, it delivers an unmatched MR rhythm action experience!

Solving Hand-Tracking’s Biggest Challenges
Hand tracking control lacks haptic feedback, and can suffer from gesture delays and imprecise controls. BEATABLE solves these issues:

- Haptic Feedback – Feel the beat with every tap on a table, clap of your hands, or a snap of your fingers—pure, natural feedback that locks you into the rhythm.
- Awesome Gesture Recognition – Lightning-fast calibration ensures precise and responsive tracking.
- Intuitive Design – Simple to start, tough to master—fun flows for all.

Collaboration and Community
Naysy, VR YouTube star and rhythm action expert, is integral to BEATABLE’s roadmap, offering gameplay insights throughout ongoing development, and leading the official teaser and launch trailers to bring the game to her fans and a global audience.

“It's been awhile since I've been so addicted to a rhythm game. I absolutely love VR rhythm games and I think BEATABLE really offers a unique take on the genre,” says Naysy. “The physical interaction paired with hand tracking just makes perfect sense and creates a truly fun immersive experience. I'm in love with this game and can't wait for everyone to experience it.”

With a pulse-pounding soundtrack featuring desk-tapping, clap-worthy tracks, BEATABLE brings together some of Yorkshire’s finest musical talents. The lineup includes 3x Platinum-selling artist Tom Zanetti, whose tracks have racked up hundreds of millions of Spotify streams, alongside the world-famous Bhangra pioneers RDB. Adding to the mix are rising stars Jamie Vice, Gamini Khurana, and Snowflake, each bringing their unique energy to the game’s electrifying beats.

Fans of Zombieland: Headshot Fever will also recognize standout tracks from the hit VR game by XR Games and Sony Pictures Virtual Reality. And elevating the experience even further, PitStop Productions—seasoned game audio experts—bring their expertise to craft additional beats that lock in perfectly with the action.

“Writing music for games is always exciting, but a rhythm game is a whole different level,” says PitStop Productions. “Here, the music isn’t just background—it’s the heartbeat of the gameplay. Every note, every beat has to land just right as you tap to the rhythm.”

The BEATABLE soundtrack will grow with our Early Access community—as the leaderboards catch fire! Join the action on Discord: https://discord.gg/TcNRzTaMp5
